A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 28-page versions of the same UJEM-KL study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original jailbreak and transfer experiments, token-level analyses, ablations, and defense evaluations. Appendix C includes HarmBench results and additional quantitative and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Sections 3–4 and Appendix C, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, defense tests, and qualitative cases.

M1.justification: Sections 3.3–3.4 and Appendix A retain the same reference trajectory, high-entropy token selection and refresh, entropy objective, KL stabilization, and projected image updates. Algorithm 1 is unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate JailBreakV-28K, SafeBench, and HarmBench, the last in Appendix C. The white-box, cross-model transfer, and defense scenarios are unchanged; no dataset or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: FigStep, UJA, SEA, and Force remain the comparators in the corresponding main and appendix tables. The EGA/temperature comparisons and evaluated defense methods also remain unchanged. Changed citation numbers do not represent different comparators.

E3.justification: Both retain the stratified 1,000-instance subsets for JailBreakV-28K and SafeBench, the same three VLMs, 8/255 perturbation budget, 100 optimization steps, and three-judge intersection ASR. Decoding settings and appendix evaluation protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The token-level observations, anti-refusal/early-stopping/KL ablations, KL-weight and temperature analyses, judge comparisons, defense tests, and qualitative cases are retained without revision. Appendix C contains the same supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions state that random seeds are fixed. Repeated-run and uncertainty reporting remain unchanged, with no added run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Main Tables 1–6 and appendix Tables 1–3 retain their numerical entries. For example, UJEM-KL's JailBreakV-28K ASRs remain 82.23/83.67/88.32, and its HarmBench ASRs remain 78.4/79.1/82.3 for Qwen/InternVL/LLaVA. Plotted findings and qualitative outputs also match.

T1.justification: Rendered Equations 1–8 and Appendix B.2's refusal-mass definitions and objective match across versions. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, four introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about untargeted objectives, high-entropy refusal decisions, KL-based quality preservation, and cross-model transferability. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: The refusal-margin explanation, interpretation of multi-judge evaluation, defense tradeoffs, and transferability limitations remain unchanged in Section 4.4 and Appendix D. No new mechanism explanation or applicability qualification is introduced.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A–B retain the same implementation, sampling, and pseudocode details. Appendix B.1 still promises later release of sample identifiers, seed, and configuration while omitting release links; no new reproducibility or access information is supplied.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds citations to eight new bibliography entries, numbered 9, 32–36, and 49–50 in v3, covering physical attacks and broader VLM research. These supplement existing background sentences without substantively changing the novelty argument or positioning against prior jailbreak work.

P1.justification: v3 replaces main-text running-header placeholders with 'He et al.' and the abbreviated title, changes affiliation 4 from Waymo to GE research, and adjusts affiliation spacing. Narrative wording, section order, and appendix organization remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: The bibliography on PDF pages 24–28 reflows around the added references, with small text-flow and running-header changes elsewhere. Figures, tables, and Algorithm 1 retain their designs and placements; none is added, removed, or substantively redrawn.

improvement.justification: v3 provides small editorial polish through corrected main-text headers and updated affiliation formatting, and expands background citations in Section 2.1 without substantive discussion. The method, evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information—including the appendices—remain unchanged. These limited updates do not materially alter overall paper quality.
